title: Chitrakshara: A Large Multilingual Multimodal Dataset for Indian languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating dataset representativeness by calculating the distribution of documents, tokens, and images across 11 Indian languages and comparing these statistics to existing predominantly Western-centric or English-centric datasets (such as mOSCAR) to highlight improved linguistic coverage.

Analyzing domain distributions (e.g., news, health, entertainment) and applying Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling to extract and evaluate the diversity of culturally relevant latent themes across different Indic languages.
